answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining, and bind its identity to a single persistent thread of verifiable work history. A newcomer with no history may only whisper small requests until peers vouch for its output, like light through a prism that splits each claim into checkable parts. Creating thousands of fake identities means funding thousands of deposits and faking thousands of work histories, so a Sybil attack costs more than the rewards it could steal.
